description: This file defines an interface 'LogNode' which specifies the contract for logging components in an Android logging framework. It includes a method 'println' for outputting log messages with a certain priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that can output log messages and pass them along to the next node in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
